product_one_liner.value: Smallest.ai provides real-time voice AI—including speech-to-text, text-to-speech, speech-to-speech, and voice-agent APIs—for enterprises and developers building voice experiences.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes its voice APIs and platform.

pricing_page.notes: Public page lists pay-as-you-go prices and enterprise pricing.

named_customers.notes: Both names appear as customer stories.

employee_band.notes: The company's LinkedIn profile reports 51–200 employees, while PitchBook reports 60 total employees; 60 places it in the requested 51–100 band.

hq_location.notes: Press kit gives a San Francisco street address; LinkedIn identifies headquarters as San Francisco, California.

founded_year.notes: The co-founder bio says the company started in 2023.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index contains many explanatory and comparison posts, but no qualifying posts describing how the product is built by engineers; technical-topic marketing posts alone do not meet the defined threshold.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation includes numerous model, API, and voice-agent guides.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live job board lists three openings, including two in Engineering; the listing titles include an AI/ML role.

model_provider.value: Smallest.ai publicly identifies its own model family (including Lightning, Pulse, Hydra, and Electron) and also documents OpenAI model integrations, including ChatGPT and a migration guide for OpenAI; it does not disclose a single exclusive underlying provider.
model_provider.notes: The docs describe in-house models and OpenAI compatibility/integration; the pricing page names ChatGPT models. No claim is made that OpenAI is the provider behind Smallest's proprietary models.

compliance_certs.notes: The security page lists SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001:2022, HIPAA, GDPR, and PCI DSS.

last_funding.notes: The company announced a $13 million Series A in July 2026; the company's own post is dated October 5, but press coverage dates the round announcement to July 31.

raised_18mo.notes: The $13 million Series A was announced July 31, 2026, within the 18-month period before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current job board shows three openings, in Engineering and Finance, and no SDR, BDR, sales representative, or account executive title.

launched_6mo.notes: The blog index includes the launch/integration announcement “Shopify + Atoms: AI Voice Order Status and Returns Support,” dated October 30, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Could not verify a sufficiently complete leadership roster or a dated announcement/profile establishing whether a C-level or VP-level leader joined or left during the period.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The integrations page is readable but names no CRM or sales-and-marketing systems; its listed products are agent, automation, SDK, AI gateway, and telephony tools.
